title: Show Command Flow
interaction_flow: opt[default/--installed]: ShowCommand → RepositoryManager::getLocalRepository() → new InstalledRepository([rootRepo, localRepo])
ShowCommand::getPackage(installedRepo, repos, name, version) → new RepositorySet('dev')
ShowCommand::generatePackageTree() → ShowCommand::addTree(requireName, link, installedRepo, repos, packagesInTree) [recursive]
ShowCommand::addTree() → ShowCommand::getPackage(installedRepo, repos, name, constraint) [recursive per dep]
loop[other repos]: ShowCommand → RepositoryInterface::getPackages(): returns PackageInterface[]
opt[--latest]: ShowCommand::execute() → ShowCommand::findLatestPackage(package, composer, platformRepo, ...flags, platformReqFilter)
opt[text + list]: ShowCommand → ShowCommand::printPackages(io, packages, ...) → IOInterface::write(row) per package
opt[single pkg, json]: ShowCommand → ShowCommand::printPackageInfoAsJson(package, versions, installedRepo, latestPackage) → IOInterface::write(JsonFile::encode(json))
opt[single pkg, text]: ShowCommand → ShowCommand::printPackageInfo(package, versions, installedRepo, latestPackage)
ShowCommand::printPackageInfo() → ShowCommand::printVersions(package, versions, installedRepo) → InstalledRepository::findPackages(name) → IOInterface::write(versions)
ShowCommand::printPackageInfo() → ShowCommand::printLinks(package, linkType) → IOInterface::write(target + constraint) per link
key_relationships: ShowCommand depends_on InstalledRepository, CompositeRepository, InstalledArrayRepository, PlatformRepository, RootPackageRepository, ComposerRepository
ShowCommand writes output exclusively via IOInterface (never direct echo)
Other repos provide getPackages() (full in-memory listing)
important_notes: ShowCommand::execute() is the sole entry point. BaseCommand::tryComposer() returns null when no composer.json exists (some options disabled gracefully). ComposerRepository uses lazy getPackageNames() to avoid downloading all metadata. Tree rendering is fully recursive via generatePackageTree→addTree (builds array) then displayPackageTree→displayTree (renders). Circular deps detected in addTree via $packagesInTree tracking. RepositorySet is cached per ShowCommand instance via $this->repositorySet. getIO() returns NullIO when no Application is set.
